text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated 5xx rate (gateway TLS handshake failures) in eu-west-1 affecting Dedicated customers. Spike started ~1987654300. Alerts: 502/524 spikes, envoy upstream TLS error logs. Paging oncall: @alice_oncall.

alice_oncall: I'm on it, grabbing dashboard links. Can everyone mute non-essential notif pls.

ben_infra: seeing a big bump in tls.handshake_failed on the regional gateway nodes. Logs show: 'tlsv1 alert unknown ca' and 'handshake failure: certificate verify failed'.

clara_sre: Confirmed customers A+B reporting 5xx for API calls. Error rate up ~18% in eu-west-1. Latency also increased.

alice_oncall: are these the recent CA rotations we pushed last night?

ben_infra: We rotated the issuing CA in the cert-rotator job at 02:10 UTC. Some nodes accepted new chain, but several edge proxies still presenting old chain to upstreams.

frank_prod: Customer-facing note: some enterprise Dedicated clusters are getting 'TLS handshake failure' and failing requests. Might be auth since we use mTLS to the backends.

david_support: Received a support ticket from customer C showing curl error: "curl: (56) SSL_READ:errno=0" and openssl s_client shows 'verify return:1' then 'verify error:num=18:self signed certificate'.

emma_sec: That openssl output suggests the chain being presented doesn't match the expected CA. Could be a rotated root or mis-signed leaf.

ben_infra: digging into rotator logs. Found errors at 1987654287: 'rotator: upload to keyvault failed - HTTP 403' then subsequent partial rollouts. Some gateways didn't fetch new CA bundles.

clara_sre: Metrics: edge-prod-gw-1 and gw-4 show handshake error rate correlating with 502 spikes. Canary nodes ok.

alice_oncall: Immediate mitigation: enable fallback path to accept legacy CA for mTLS within gateway policy (temp), and disable strict cert enforcement for dedicated customers while we clean rotator. Is that doable?

ben_infra: I can push a gateway policy change to relax CA verification for the affected customer IDs only. Will do a canary roll in eu-west-1.

frank_prod: Please scope to the affected tenant IDs. We must avoid broad insecure policy change.

ben_infra: Preparing rollout. Command: ```kubectl apply -f gateway-fallback-eu.yaml``` payload includes allowed_ca_thumbprints: ["OLD_CA_SHA256_FOO..."] and tenant filters.

alice_oncall: Clara, coordinate canary and traffic check. I'll call out to customers later.

clara_sre: Canary applied to gw-1 in eu-west-1. Traffic to canary shows error rate dropped to baseline within 3 minutes for Tenant A. Monitoring for 15m.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423, severity: high, owner: alice_oncall. Handoff window scheduled at 1987654400 if still active.

david_support: Notifying affected customers about degraded service and mitigation in progress. Draft message: "We're investigating TLS handshake errors in eu-west-1 impacting Dedicated clusters. We've applied a targeted fallback and are continuing remediation. We'll update in 30m"

emma_sec: We should also rotate any compromised tokens/keys if rotator error included 403 from vault - check IAM audit.

ben_infra: Rotator job diagnostics: ```ERROR rotator: vault upload 403 forbidden, response: access denied for service-account:cert-rotator-eu``` Looks like service account lost role binding after infra change.

alice_oncall: Who changed IAM role bindings?

ben_infra: Reviewing audit logs... found automated terraform apply at 1987654100 modified iam_binding for cert-rotator in eu project. Might be the root cause.

frank_prod: Action items: 1) restore IAM binding for cert-rotator 2) re-run rotator to push CA bundles 3) maintain gateway fallback until all nodes have new chain 4) postmortem.

clara_sre: I've kept fallback in place for affected tenant IDs only. Will remove after verification.

alice_oncall: Assigning tasks: ben => restore IAM + rerun rotator; clara => monitor gateways + remove fallback after confirmation; david => customer comms; emma => audit creds; frank => coordinate postmortem.

ben_infra: Restored IAM binding at 1987654388 and re-ran rotator. Rotator logs: 'upload OK' and subsequent push to nodes. Pushing restart to gateway pods on nodes that still present old chain.

clara_sre: After restart and rotator push, handshake errors down to baseline across eu-west-1. No further 5xx alerts for 10m.

alice_oncall: Great. Start rollback of fallback policy but keep monitoring for one more full rotation cycle (~30m).

incident-bot: Handoff reminder: @clara_sre will take next oncall window at 1987654400.

david_support: Sent customer update: "Temporary fallback enabled while we completed CA recap; full fix deployed via rotator. Please report if you still see errors."

emma_sec: Audits show terraform change was approved by infra-automation; adding guardrails to prevent iam removal for cert-rotator. Proposing an org-level policy.

frank_prod: Filing postmortem ticket PM-198765 with root cause: terraform removed role binding for cert-rotator causing partial CA rollouts; mitigation: targeted gateway fallback, IAM restore, rotator rerun.

clara_sre: Closing incident channel once fallback removed and 1h of stable metrics. Current status: mitigated, monitoring.

alice_oncall: Thanks team. Leaving note for postmortem: include timelines, terraform diff, rotator retry logic, and customer comms. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0423 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
